messages:
jamal: FinTrust needs Q12 answered in the SIG about tenant isolation and wants an evidence bundle (diagram, network policy, smoke-test). Can we ship by EOD tomorrow?

maria: I can draft the narrative. Need a sanitized arch diagram and an example NetworkPolicy. @alex can you supply KMS details and a storage-prefix example?

alex: Will provide a redacted draw.io export and a minimal NetworkPolicy YAML. Note: must remove internal hostnames/IPs. Example aliases I'll include.

sarah: From security: include a short threat-model mapping and smoke-test acceptance criteria (no cross-tenant read, audit events generated). Also mention key rotation cadence.

nina: I can assemble the ZIP. Proposed artifact names: fintrust-dataflow.png, ns-isolation.yaml, kms-summary.pdf, smoketest-2026-03-19.log.zip. Where to upload? GDrive or S3?

jamal: S3 preferred for the portal. Also legal may ask for an attestation later; flagging that.

alex: Inline examples for SIG (sanitized):
```bash
s3://redwood-hosted/customer-REDACTED/data/
alias/redwood/customer-REDACTED
```

maria: Draft narrative v0: "Redwood separates tenant data using distinct storage prefixes, per-tenant encryption keys (hosted) or customer-managed keys (Dedicated/Private), namespace-level network segmentation, and RBAC enforced by the control plane." Feedback?

sarah: Minor edit: add noisy-tenant remediation steps and confirm KMS audit log retention. Otherwise LGTM.

nina: Uploaded interim artifacts to S3 (private): s3://redwood-internal/sig/fintrust-1837654321/ (links pending). Will remove hostnames from logs before final.

jamal: Owners: @maria finalize narrative, @alex attach redacted snippets, @nina create final ZIP, @sarah sign off. Target: tomorrow 18:00 PST. Any blockers?

alex: No blockers. I'll also add a tiny terraform placeholder and the rotation doc name.

nina: Final ZIP uploaded: s3://redwood-internal/sig/fintrust-1837654321-final.zip. Ready for submission once @sarah signs off.

jamal: Thanks all — I'll submit to FinTrust portal after sign-off.
